name: Bungalows at The Boca Raton
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive waterfront retreat offers just 60 intimate bungalows scattered across a private peninsula, making it one of South Florida's most coveted hideaways.
whats_special: The Bungalows occupy a stunning 200-acre private island connected to the mainland Boca Raton Resort, accessible only by boat shuttle. Each free-standing bungalow features its own private dock, and the property boasts the deepest natural harbor between Fort Lauderdale and Palm Beach. The resort's Lake Boca originally served as a World War II training facility for the Army Air Forces.
pro_tip: Book a bungalow on the eastern shore for breathtaking sunrise views over Lake Boca, and request the complimentary boat shuttle schedule to easily hop between the island and the main resort's amenities.
dont_miss: The private yacht excursions departing directly from your bungalow dock, sunset cocktails at the overwater Water Stone Bar & Grill, and exploring the resort's championship golf courses designed by Pete Dye. The nearby Gumbo Limbo Nature Center offers incredible sea turtle nesting experiences during summer months.
pros: Intimate bungalow-style accommodations with private terraces
Direct beach access to pristine Atlantic coastline
Luxury amenities including world-class spa and golf courses
Prime Boca Raton location near upscale shopping and dining
cons: Limited number of bungalow units may require advance booking
